performance.verdict: Spend is erratic and throttled; leads are zero — intake gap, not ads.

findings.text: Leads field reads 0 for all 28 days despite 15 Google Ads conversions and 39 GBP calls — attribution pipeline broken or CRM intake seat empty since Vivian left 7/7.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and shows no completed event — GHL automation readiness unverified while speed-to-lead seat is vacant.

Spend is wildly irregular — 14 of 28 days show $0 or under $20, peaking at $248.50 on 7/27; 3-day signal (8/16–8/18: $9.12, $18.71, $16.06) is near-zero vs prior 3 days ($130.18 avg). Intentional throttle is confirmed in SOW, but pattern suggests budget pacing is not smooth.
GBP actions dropped 25% week-over-week (last 3 days: 8, 0, 0 vs prior 3: 3, 5, 5) — organic local signal fading, though Windsor data lag in last 2–3 days may account for the zeros.
GHL shows 44 opportunities created and 6 won (28d) but 0 appointments logged — pipeline values are $0, suggesting deal-stage data or dollar tagging is not being entered.

suggestions.text: Confirm who owns GHL intake seat after Vivian's 7/7 departure; verify login, after-hours coverage, and speed-to-lead automation target.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left on 7/7 and the intake seat backing speed-to-lead automations may be unmanned. Confirm the named replacement, their active GHL login, and after-hours coverage before any budget is raised. The 28-day leads field reads 0 despite 15 Google Ads conversions and 39 GBP calls — this gap cannot be resolved by ads alone. Success check: a named GHL owner confirmed by Nacer/Xavier by 2026-08-22.

suggestions.text: Battle-test the booking bot in GHL and log a confirmed pass/fail — overdue since 2026-07-31.
